final: WITH valid AS (SELECT sc.zoneref AS zone_code, t.healtheval AS status, sc.gbsize, sc.spanmin FROM scans sc JOIN sites t ON sc.zoneref = t.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), grp AS (SELECT zone_code, status, AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 THEN gbsize * 1.0 / spanmin END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM valid GROUP BY zone_code, status), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg FROM grp) SELECT g.zone_code, g.status, g.avg_ratio, g.scan_count, g.avg_ratio - m.mean_avg AS excess FROM grp g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_ratio > m.mean_avg ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
